units.title: SG-4.2.5 · Untrack the conflicted vitest cache and dedupe conflict-stage listings
Act: Dedupe and strip stage prefixes in parseGitLsFiles
Act: Force cached removal of results.json in untrackNodeModules
Verify: parseGitLsFiles and checkTrackedFiles dedupe conflict entries

tests.name: deduplicates conflict stage entries
tests.title: parseGitLsFiles deduplicates conflict stage entries
tests.scenario: Given git ls-files --stage output with one path at stages 1, 2 and 3, when parsed, then the path is returned once with stage prefixes stripped
tests.detail: Passes; stage prefixes stripped and duplicates removed.

tests.name: deduplicates a triplicated NUL-separated plain path to one entry
tests.title: parseGitLsFiles deduplicates a triplicated NUL-separated plain path to one entry
tests.scenario: Given NUL-separated output listing the same plain path three times, when parsed, then the result contains that path exactly once
tests.detail: Passes; the Set-based dedupe returns a single entry.

tests.name: reports a conflicted path once
tests.title: checkTrackedFiles reports a conflicted path once
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner listing the vitest results cache file three times plus src/a.ts, when checkTrackedFiles runs, then the conflicted path is reported exactly once

units.title: Verify: untrackNodeModules force-removes the conflicted results.json

tests.name: removes node_modules from the git index recursively using a cached-only rm
tests.title: untrackNodeModules removes node_modules from the git index recursively using a cached-only rm
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner returning empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called, then one call is rm -r --cached node_modules

tests.name: only ever uses the --cached flag so working-tree files are never deleted
tests.title: untrackNodeModules only ever uses the --cached flag so working-tree files are never deleted
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner returning empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called, then every git call carries --cached

tests.name: also untracks the vitest results cache file under node_modules
tests.title: untrackNodeModules also untracks the vitest results cache file under node_modules
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner returning empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called, then one call names node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json

tests.name: force-removes conflicted results.json from the index with a cached-only forced rm
tests.title: untrackNodeModules force-removes the conflicted results.json from the index with a cached-only forced rm
tests.scenario: Given a fake git runner returning empty output, when untrackNodeModules is called, then the second call is rm --cached -f --ignore-unmatch -q -- node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json and every call includes --cached

units.title: REQ · parseGitLsFiles deduplicates conflict stage entries
REQ · Cleanup untracks the conflicted vitest results.json and clears its index entry
Evidence: conflict dedupe and cache untracking unit tests pass
